# Baker Air Inc. - HVAC Services

> Baker Air Inc. is a family-owned HVAC company serving the Temecula Valley in Southern California. We provide professional heating, ventilation, and air conditioning services including installation, repair, maintenance, and indoor air quality solutions.

## Company Information

- **Business Name:** Baker Air Inc.
- **Type:** HVAC Contractor (Heating, Ventilation, Air Conditioning)
- **Location:** Winchester, CA 92596
- **Service Area:** Temecula, Menifee, Murrieta, Winchester, Wildomar, Lake Elsinore
- **Phone:** (951) 348-0686
- **Email:** office.bakerair@gmail.com
- **License:** California Contractor License #1098493

## Services Offered

### HVAC Installation & Upgrades
Professional installation of heating and cooling systems including:
- Central Air Conditioning systems
- Ductless Mini-Split systems
- Gas Furnaces
- Heat Pumps
- Smart Thermostats
- Complete system replacements and upgrades

### AC & Heating Repair
Fast, reliable repair services:
- Same-day service available
- All major brands serviced
- Honest, upfront pricing
- Diagnostic and troubleshooting
- Emergency repairs

### Preventative Maintenance - The Comfy Club
Membership program including:
- 2 maintenance visits per year (Spring AC tune-up, Fall heating tune-up)
- 15% discount on all repairs
- Priority scheduling
- $97 service fee waived
- 26-point AC inspection
- 18-point heating inspection

### Indoor Air Quality Solutions
- Whole-home air purifiers
- UV air purification systems
- High-efficiency MERV filters (MERV 8-16)
- Duct cleaning recommendations
- Humidity control solutions

## Business Hours

- Monday - Saturday: 7:00 AM - 5:00 PM
- Sunday: Closed
- Emergency service available 24/7
